description: This source file contains functions for generating and configuring CU-CP (Central Unit - Control Plane) configurations, including QoS, security, timers, mobility, and network connection settings, as well as functions for filling worker manager configurations. It implements detailed configuration logic for 5QI QoS, security algorithms, report configurations, and network connection parameters, specific to 3GPP specifications.

methods.name: generate_cu_cp_qos_config
methods.description: Generates a map of QoS configurations based on the provided CU-CP unit configuration, including RLC mode, header compression, SN sizes, discard timers, and out-of-order delivery settings.

methods.name: generate_preferred_integrity_algorithms_list
methods.description: Creates a list of preferred integrity algorithms from the security configuration string.

methods.name: generate_preferred_ciphering_algorithms_list
methods.description: Creates a list of preferred ciphering algorithms from the security configuration string.

methods.name: generate_rrc_ssb_mtc
methods.description: Generates RRC SSB measurement timing configuration with specified period, offset, and duration.

methods.name: generate_cu_cp_periodical_report_config
methods.description: Builds a periodical report configuration for CU-CP based on report parameters.

methods.name: build_meas_trigger_threshold
methods.description: Constructs measurement trigger quantities for absolute thresholds (A1, A2, A4, A5) following 3GPP TS 38.331 encoding.

methods.name: build_meas_trigger_offset
methods.description: Constructs measurement trigger quantities for relative offsets (A3, A6) following 3GPP TS 38.331 encoding.

methods.name: generate_cu_cp_trigger_report_config
methods.description: Builds a trigger-based report configuration for CU-CP based on event type and measurement parameters.

methods.name: generate_cu_cp_config
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive CU-CP configuration object, including network, security, timers, mobility, and report settings, based on input configuration.

methods.name: generate_n2_client_config
methods.description: Generates network connection client configuration, supporting both no-core and core-based modes, with AMF address and SCTP parameters.

methods.name: fill_cu_cp_worker_manager_config
methods.description: Populates worker manager configuration with CU-CP executor and PCAP settings based on the unit configuration.
